title: Ship a pitch deck
promise: Turn a rough idea into a clean slide deck you can present or send.
audience: Founders, students and anyone with ten minutes on someone's calendar

steps.title: Outline the story in notes
steps.why: Writing the argument as plain notes first means the slides only have to carry it, not invent it.

steps.title: Sketch the one diagram that matters
steps.why: Excalidraw is a hand-drawn-style whiteboard in the browser; the rough look keeps you from polishing a diagram before it is right.

steps.title: Find a cover photo
steps.why: One full-bleed image gives the first slide a point of view, and Unsplash images are free to use.

steps.title: Build the deck
steps.why: Canva's free tier has presentation templates and can present from the browser or export a PDF, though some templates and features are paid.
